'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Wirfs LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirfs]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Speeder Bowl XL (2nd Half)'''. Printed name reads Chris Wirks. No starting mark; line 3 is Communing. Transcription notes: Line 39 written ''Crimson Muse''; Line 46 written ''Wedge Antilles RS2''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine: Slave Quarters]]
* '''Username:''' Shouldbewirks
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
